description: This file defines interfaces for the xdiff library, including typedefs, function prototypes for diff computation, reading files, and comparison utilities. It serves as an interface layer for diff-related functionalities.

methods.name: xdiff_diff
methods.description: Computes the difference between two memory-mapped files, taking diff parameters and a callback for output.

methods.name: xdiff_diff_outf
methods.description: Outputs the diff between two files using provided callback functions for hunks and lines.

methods.name: read_mmfile
methods.description: Reads a file into a memory-mapped file structure.

methods.name: read_mmblob
methods.description: Reads binary object data into a memory-mapped file structure based on object ID.

methods.name: buffer_is_binary
methods.description: Checks whether the given buffer contains binary data.

methods.name: xdiff_set_find_func
methods.description: Sets a custom find function for diff conflict detection.

methods.name: xdiff_clear_find_func
methods.description: Clears any custom find function set for diff conflict detection.

methods.name: parse_conflict_style_name
methods.description: Parses a conflict style name string and returns an identifier.

methods.name: git_xmerge_config
methods.description: Configures xmerge style and behavior based on provided variable and value.

methods.name: xdiff_compare_lines
methods.description: Compares two lines with flags indicating whitespace handling, returns 1 if equal.

methods.name: xdiff_hash_string
methods.description: Computes a hash of a string with specified flags for whitespace handling.

ctags.name: xdiff_emit_hunk_fn
ctags.typeref: typename:void (*)(void * data,long old_begin,long old_nr,long new_begin,long new_nr,const char * func,long funclen)
